newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Banque Misr funds to increase capital.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Banque Misr funds to increase capital.

text.p: Egypt's state-owned Banque Misr wants to increase the capital of its two mutual funds by 100 million pounds ($29.5 million) each and invited investors to contribute, the fund manager said on Monday.

Concord International Investments said that investors could buy up to 100,000 units in the first mutual fund which distributes yields every quarter and which will increase its capital to 400 million from 300 million pounds.
Investors can also buy the same number of units in the second growth-oriented fund, increasing its capital to 300 million. Units are priced at 1,000 pounds each.
Concord said the offer would remain open until it was fully covered. The offer opened on April 21.
Both funds invest in equities and government papers.
